author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam visits Sideshow's paint department to learn from Production Manager Anthony Mestas (Sideshow's former lead painter) his techniques for painting and weathering diorama environments for Sideshow's statues and figures! Here's how to effectively use alcohol inks to create the look of rust, deterioration, and grime on your models.  

Sideshow's new Han Solo™ Premium Format™ Figure: https://side.show/smuggler

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
